description: This file implements the Hibernate-specific data access object (DAO) for User entities in the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting users, as well as handling passwords, roles, privileges, and credentials with Hibernate ORM.

classes.name: HibernateUserDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the UserDAO interface, providing database operations for User entities using Hibernate ORM in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database interactions.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves or updates a User object in the database, with password handling if it's a new User.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username or system ID.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a User by email address.

methods.name: getLoginCredentialByActivationKey
methods.description: Fetches a LoginCredential entity by activation key after encoding and pattern matching.

methods.name: hasDuplicateUsername
methods.description: Checks if a username, system ID, or related identifier already exists, considering check-digit validation.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches a User by their internal ID.

methods.name: getAllUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all non-retired users, excluding daemon users.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the database.

methods.name: getUsersByRole
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a specified role.

methods.name: getAllPrivileges
methods.description: Lists all privileges available.

methods.name: getPrivilege
methods.description: Fetches a privilege by its name.

methods.name: deletePrivilege
methods.description: Removes a privilege.

methods.name: savePrivilege
methods.description: Creates or updates a privilege.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Deletes a role.

methods.name: saveRole
methods.description: Creates or updates a role.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Lists all roles.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves a role by its name.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes a user's password, ensuring proper caller validation.

methods.name: changeHashedPassword
methods.description: Updates a user's password with a pre-hashed value.

methods.name: getPrivilegeByUuid
methods.description: Gets a Privilege entity by UUID.

methods.name: getRoleByUuid
methods.description: Gets a Role entity by UUID.

methods.name: getUserByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by UUID.

methods.name: getLoginCredential
methods.description: Fetches LoginCredential for a given user.

methods.name: getLoginCredentialByUuid
methods.description: Fetches LoginCredential by UUID.

methods.name: updateLoginCredential
methods.description: Updates an existing LoginCredential.

methods.name: getUsersByPerson
methods.description: Fetches users associated with a specific Person entity.

methods.name: getCountOfUsers
methods.description: Returns a count of users matching criteria.

methods.name: setUserActivationKey
methods.description: Stores the activation key (LoginCredential).

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Retrieves the last login timestamp for a user.
